newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes firmer, retains early edge.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes firmer, retains early edge.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka retained an early edge to close firmer at 43.7500/7600 to the dollar in interbank trading on Monday amid dollar selling by some foreign banks, dealers said. The previous close was at 43.7550/7700.
"Many of them (foreign banks) had gone long on dollars and sold liberally. Some sold in need of the local currency amid tight liquidity," said a dealer.

The interbank call money rates closed lower at 8.0 to 9.0 percent against the previous 12-14 percent. Call rates turned softer as the market received about 850 million taka against previously matured central bank bills. - Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
